reviews.t: Great product for daily use with fine, long, natural hair!
reviews.x: I used this products religiously.  I have tried everything out there and have found that for a daily cleanse of long fine hair, this product is perfect.  I do not treat my hair and like my hair to feel light and airy without a frizz and static look.  This product never dries my hair, protects against split ends (though I'm not sure it advertises this), and is perfect for me.  I have used it for years and only now discovered it helps a great deal with my kids' when they get too much sun on their

reviews.t: Good for thick coarse Asian hair
reviews.x: I love this conditioner.  I have super thick, coarse, dry hair and this isn't a miracle, but works the best of all other conditioners I've used.  It makes my hair softer and smells nice.

Biosilk is my brand! Except to get thick hair and moisturized hair I think you have to lose hair? I’m not sure. I love how it smells - an old school conditioner smell. I also like how my hair feels when I use it. The only downside is that I’m losing hair more than normal and that may be from this or it may be from losing weight. Not sure but it’s coinciding so I have to mark it down a bit.

reviews.t: Silk, yes, it does make your hair silky
reviews.x: I love this conditioner. Once I use up the other kinds I have, this will be the only conditioner I buy from now on.

I have long, thick wavy hair and I have tried so many conditioners over the years.  This by far is one of the best I have ever used.  I am not sure why most people do not like it.  After I rinse it out, my hair feels so smooth and soft and it smells real good too.  My hair frizzes up easily when it starts to dry but after I use this conditioner, it is half as frizzy as it normally would be.  I follow up with Biosilk drops and the Biosilk smoothing spray before I use my flat iron and my hair has

I use BioSilk shampoo, conditioner, and oil and it makes my dry, wavy and graying hair unbelievably soft, smooth, and shiny. The products smell excellent, too. I only have to use about half of what I do for cheaper products so it works out to be a good value.

The bottle arrived with a broken cap which didn’t really concern me as I replace it with a pump. I later discovered that the bottle also was cracked on the bottom which I didn’t discover until product leaked out everywhere.
I have really dry and frizzy curls, and this product has been a life changer for me!!

I stopped coloring my hair and a lot of people complain about "wiry" hair as they, making it difficult to grow out their hair. I love Biosilk as I've been able to wear my hair long even in it's white/grey phase. I also use the shampoo and 17 Miracle leave-in conditioner.

reviews.t: THe Best Conditioner I Know Of
reviews.x: I've been using it for over 15 years. Its expensive, so the CVS's of the world stopped carrying it.

reviews.t: Bio Silk conditioner is a superior detangler.
reviews.x: Bio Silk conditioner is a superior detangler. For those with long hair, you know how hard it is to find any detangler that works well and does not leave your hair weighted-down or dull. I use both the Bio Silk shampoo and conditioner and appreciate the fact that it actually restores the texture and appearance of my hair. Even if I use a different shampoo or don’t feel the need to condition, I prefer to finish with a pumpful of Bio Silk at the ends of my hair to ease my comb-out. It tames my damp

My daughter loves this shampoo for her crazy, curly hair!  I have straight hair and have no clue what to do to help her with her beautiful hair.  We are trying different things (we tried no 'poo and she doesn't love that method), and so far the BioSilk has been her favorite line.
love this conditioner!  does not add weight to hair and makes it soft and smooth.  Works great on fine hair.  Compliments its shampoo wonderfully!
I just hope they don’t raise the price like the leave in conditioner and or stop making it

reviews.t: Awesome product & they are cheaper online!
reviews.x: LOVE being able to order these online, so much cheaper!
This is the best conditioner l have ever used.

I love BioSilk Leave In Conditioner but it's difficult to find. I decided to try this instead and I was very surprised at the excellent results. Most rinsed conditioners rinse out, leaving my long hair tangled and hard to brush after washing. This product provided silkiness without oiliness or heaviness that would weigh down my hair. I love being surprised by excellent results!

reviews.t: Nope, didn't make my hair silky
reviews.x: Well I'm glad to hear that it helped someone but for me it didn't do anything good. I have very long hair (past my booty :) and needed something that would soften my hair. I don't have split ends but sometimes my hair looks kind of frizzy and fly awayish. It left my hair feeling coated and did nothing to make it silky for me :( Used Matrix from Target and it worked great.

I have long, coarse, thick, wavy hair. This is the best product I've found to make my hair tangle-free, smooth and silky. My fifteen year old granddaughter has inherited my hair (minus the gray), past her waist, and I now buy her bottles as well and she loves it too. Gets compliments all the time.

Definitely love this product! I recently dyed my hair ash blonde from brunette & my hair was sooo dry. After using this product my hair isn't as healthy as before but definitely softer than ever! I purchased 2 sets! Really satisfied!

I have very damaged hair from blow-drying and straightening it almost every day...this stuff is like MAGIC! It makes it feel and look so much healthier and soft...I love it! I definitely recommend it!

claims.text: Reviewers frequently praise the conditioner for leaving hair soft, smooth, and silky.
Many reviewers say it works well for their specific hair types, including fine, thick, coarse, wavy, and curly hair.
Multiple reviewers mention liking the product's scent.
A few reviewers note the product is expensive or value concerns, though some find it cheaper online or a good value due to needing less.
One reviewer reports increased hair loss and another received a damaged, leaking bottle.
